name: Empress Donata

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Close Attachment
traits.details: each ally that starts its turn within the aura can shift 1 square as a minor action instead of as a move action.

auras.name: Close Attachment
auras.details: each ally that starts its turn within the aura can shift 1 square as a minor action instead of as a move action.

hit.description: damage, Empress Donata slides the target 3 squares, and the target is knocked prone

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: targets one enemy in the burst

hit.description: the target is dominated until the end of Empress Donata’s next turn. A creature dominated in this way is considered an ally with regard to Empress Donata’s other powers

effect.description: an ally in the burst makes a basic attack as a free action. Empress Donata cannot use this power on the same creature more than once in a round

An ally within 3 squares of Empress Donata shifts 3 squares, ending the move adjacent to her. Empress Donata gains a +4 bonus to all defenses against the triggering attack. If the attack misses Empress Donata, it instead hits the ally who shifted adjacent to her.
